components.name: breadcrumb
components.description: Renders the user location in a hierarchy of pages or views.

usage.description: Use Breadcrumb near the top of a page when users need to understand or move through nested context.
bestPractices: Keep labels short and recognizable.
Use links for ancestors and plain text for the current item.
avoid: Do not use Breadcrumb as primary navigation.

components.name: button
components.description: Triggers an immediate action such as submitting, saving, or opening a surface.

usage.description: Use Button for explicit actions. It inherits size, disabled, and variant defaults from TaoProvider.
bestPractices: Prefer one primary action per view or decision area.
Use loading when an action is pending.
Pass a native type when using a button inside a form.
avoid: Do not use Button for simple navigation when a link is more accurate.

props.name: size
props.description: Control size, falling back to TaoProvider.

props.name: loading
props.description: Disables the button and sets aria-busy.

components.name: checkbox
components.description: Selects one or more independent boolean options.

usage.description: Use Checkbox for independent choices, or CheckboxGroup when users can select multiple options from a set.
bestPractices: Use clear labels that describe the checked state.
Group related options with CheckboxGroup.
avoid: Do not use CheckboxGroup when only one option may be selected; use RadioGroup instead.

components.name: collapsible
components.description: Shows and hides a region of content while keeping disclosure state accessible.

usage.description: Use Collapsible to hide secondary details while preserving a lightweight page layout.
bestPractices: Make the trigger label describe the hidden content.
Use controlled open state when it must coordinate with other UI.
avoid: Do not hide required form inputs in a collapsed region without a clear cue.

components.name: context-menu
components.description: Displays contextual actions from a right click or long press interaction.

usage.description: Use ContextMenu for secondary actions attached to an object or region.
bestPractices: Keep items short and action-oriented.
Provide another reachable path for critical actions.
avoid: Do not put primary workflows only inside a context menu.

components.name: date-picker
components.description: Lets users enter or choose a single date, with optional time selection.

usage.description: Use DatePicker when free text date input would be error-prone or when users benefit from calendar context.
bestPractices: Support keyboard entry for known dates.
Use presets for common relative choices when helpful.
avoid: Do not force calendar navigation for dates far in the past without typed input.

components.name: drawer
components.description: Opens a side panel for related tasks without leaving the current page.

usage.description: Use Drawer for inspection, editing, or supporting workflows that should stay connected to the current page.
bestPractices: Use a clear title and predictable close affordance.
Keep destructive confirmations in a dedicated confirmation step.
avoid: Do not stack multiple drawers for a single workflow.

components.name: dropdown
components.description: Opens a menu of actions or navigation choices from a trigger.

usage.description: Use Dropdown for compact action sets that do not need to stay visible.
bestPractices: Order frequent actions first.
Use destructive styling only for destructive items.
avoid: Do not use Dropdown as a replacement for visible primary navigation.

components.name: form-actions
components.description: Lays out submit, cancel, and secondary actions for forms.

usage.description: Use FormActions at the end of a form or section to align the final actions consistently.
bestPractices: Keep action order consistent across forms.
Use a single submit action unless the workflow truly branches.

components.name: form-field
components.description: Associates labels, help text, validation state, and controls.

usage.description: Use FormField to provide accessible labeling and status text around a single control.
bestPractices: Connect every input with a visible label.
Keep validation copy specific and actionable.

components.name: form-layout
components.description: Arranges form content with consistent label and control alignment.

usage.description: Use FormLayout to keep dense forms aligned and predictable.
bestPractices: Use one layout strategy per form.
Prefer vertical layout on narrow screens.

components.name: form-section
components.description: Groups related form fields with a title and optional description.

usage.description: Use FormSection to break long forms into scannable groups.
bestPractices: Use headings that describe the group, not the control type.
Keep each section focused on one user decision area.

components.name: headless-input-number
components.description: Headless numeric input primitives and hook for custom number entry experiences.

usage.description: Use the headless API when tao-ui styling is not appropriate but number formatting behavior should stay consistent.
bestPractices: Use useNumberInput for fully custom rendering.
Reuse the validation helpers for parity with the styled InputNumber.

components.name: input
components.description: Single-line text input for short freeform values.

usage.description: Use Input for short text values such as names, filters, search terms, and identifiers.
bestPractices: Pair with FormField for labels and validation.
Use type, inputMode, and autoComplete when applicable.

components.name: input-number
components.description: A styled numeric input built on tao-ui number formatting and validation behavior.

usage.description: Use InputNumber for numeric values that need min, max, step, precision, or formatted display.
bestPractices: Set min and max when the domain is bounded.
Use the headless API when custom rendering is required.
avoid: Do not use a numeric input for identifiers such as account numbers.

components.name: modal
components.description: Displays a focused dialog for decisions, forms, and interruptive information.

usage.description: Use Modal for focused tasks or decisions. Static helpers such as Modal.confirm mirror common confirmation flows.
bestPractices: Prefer Modal.useModal inside React trees so dialogs inherit TaoProvider context.
Keep modal content short and task-oriented.
avoid: Do not use nested modals for multi-step workflows.

components.name: pagination
components.description: Moves through paged data with current page and page-size controls.

usage.description: Use Pagination when a collection is split into pages rather than infinitely loaded.
bestPractices: Keep the current page controlled when data is loaded remotely.
Show total counts when they help users judge scope.

components.name: radio
components.description: Selects exactly one option from a mutually exclusive set.

usage.description: Use RadioGroup when every option is visible and only one can be selected.
bestPractices: Use concise labels.
Provide a default value when one option is recommended or required.
avoid: Do not use RadioGroup for very long option lists; use Select instead.

components.name: range-picker
components.description: Lets users select a start and end date as one range value.

usage.description: Use RangePicker for reporting windows, booking windows, and filters with start/end dates.
bestPractices: Use presets for common ranges such as today, this week, or last 30 days.
Make inclusive/exclusive range behavior clear when it matters.

components.name: scroll-area
components.description: Provides a styled scroll container for overflow content.

usage.description: Use ScrollArea when a fixed region needs overflow behavior without changing page scroll.
bestPractices: Constrain height explicitly.
Avoid hiding important actions below a small scroll region.

components.name: select
components.description: Chooses one value from a compact list of options.

usage.description: Use Select when choices are known but too numerous or secondary to show as radios.
bestPractices: Use RadioGroup when there are only a few important choices.
Keep option labels stable and easy to scan.
avoid: Do not use Select for arbitrary text entry.

components.name: spinner
components.description: Indicates indeterminate loading activity.

usage.description: Use Spinner for short indeterminate waits when progress cannot be measured.
bestPractices: Prefer inline placement near the content that is loading.
Use aria labels for standalone spinners.
avoid: Do not use Spinner for determinate progress.

components.name: splitter
components.description: Creates resizable panes separated by draggable handles.

usage.description: Use Splitter for work surfaces where users need to allocate space between adjacent panes.
bestPractices: Set sensible min sizes.
Persist sizes only when the layout is user-specific.

components.name: stack
components.description: Composes children in a flex row or column with consistent spacing.

usage.description: Use Stack for simple one-dimensional layout and spacing.
bestPractices: Prefer Stack over one-off margin rules for repeated spacing.
Use semantic containers when the layout has richer meaning.

components.name: switch
components.description: Toggles a setting on or off with immediate effect.

usage.description: Use Switch for settings that take effect immediately.
bestPractices: Use labels that describe the enabled state.
Use Checkbox when the value is submitted with a form.

components.name: table
components.description: Displays structured row and column data with selection, sorting, filtering, and pagination hooks.

usage.description: Use Table for dense, comparable records that benefit from aligned columns.
bestPractices: Keep columns focused on the task.
Use stable row keys.
Control sorting and pagination when data is remote.
avoid: Do not use Table for card-like content where comparison is not important.

components.name: tabs
components.description: Switches between peer panels within the same page context.

usage.description: Use Tabs to separate peer views without navigating away from the current task.
bestPractices: Use short tab labels.
Keep tab panels at comparable hierarchy.
avoid: Do not use Tabs for sequential steps.

components.name: tag
components.description: Displays compact labels, statuses, categories, or checkable chips.

usage.description: Use Tag for lightweight metadata or status markers. Use CheckableTag for compact filter choices.
bestPractices: Use semantic colors consistently.
Keep tag text short.
avoid: Do not encode critical state by color alone.

components.name: tao-provider
components.description: Provides global component defaults, portal scoping, and theme seed token overrides.

usage.description: Wrap an app or subtree with TaoProvider to set size, disabled, variant, and theme defaults.
bestPractices: Prefer provider-level defaults for app-wide decisions.
Use nested providers for scoped theme overrides.
avoid: Do not override derived CSS variables directly unless a theme token cannot express the change.

props.name: theme
props.description: Seed token overrides for the provider scope.

components.name: textarea
components.description: Multi-line text input with optional auto sizing.

usage.description: Use Textarea for longer freeform content such as descriptions, notes, and comments.
bestPractices: Set rows or autoSize based on expected content length.
Use maxLength when limits are strict.
